## Reading Files: HCHS/SOL V1

```{r importing, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

#Be sure to replace the file path with the appropriate file path on your own computer. 

# >>>>> VISIT 1 <<<<<<

library(readr)

base_dir <- "/Users/adriana/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Emory/0 Emory/Rollins/thesis/Tesis - Rollins/csv V1 main study"

file_paths <- c(
  file.path(base_dir, "part_derv_lad1.csv"),
  file.path(base_dir, "piea_lad1.csv"),
  file.path(base_dir, "rsea_lad1.csv"),
  file.path(base_dir, "mhea_lad1.csv"),
  file.path(base_dir, "muea_lad1.csv"),
  file.path(base_dir, "laba_lad1.csv"),
  file.path(base_dir, "anta_lad1.csv"),
  file.path(base_dir, "sbpa_lad1.csv")
)

for (i in seq_along(file_paths)) {
  oname <- paste0("df", i)
  assign(oname, read_csv(file_paths[i]), envir = .GlobalEnv)
}
```

## Cleaning: HCHS/SOL V1

```{r merging-V1, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#merging the data set
data_sol_v1 <- merge(df1, df2,  by ="PID", all = T) 
data_sol_v1 <- merge(data_sol_v1, df3,  by ="PID", all = T)
data_sol_v1 <- merge(data_sol_v1, df4,  by ="PID", all = T)
data_sol_v1 <- merge(data_sol_v1, df5,  by ="PID", all = T)
data_sol_v1 <- merge(data_sol_v1, df6,  by ="PID", all = T)
data_sol_v1 <- merge(data_sol_v1, df7,  by ="PID", all = T)
data_sol_v1 <- merge(data_sol_v1, df8,  by ="PID", all = T)

# cleaning
rm(df1, df2, df3, df4, df5,
   df6, df7, df8, file_paths, i, oname)

attach(data_sol_v1)

#creating new data frame which only has the variables of interest
df_sol_v1 <- data.frame(
  id_study = 'HCHS_SOL_V1',
  id       = PID,
  
  psu1     = as.numeric(PSU_ID),       # check when merging
  psu2     = as.numeric(PSU_CNT),
  
  stratum1 = as.numeric(STRAT),
  stratum2 = as.numeric(STRAT_CNT),

  psu_weight1 = as.numeric(WEIGHT_FINAL_NORM_OVERALL),
  psu_weight2 = as.numeric(WEIGHT_FINAL_EXPANDED),
  psu_weight3 = as.numeric(WEIGHT_FINAL_NORM_CENTER),
  
  # demographics
  sex     = PIEA1, 
  age     = as.numeric(AGE),
  race    = PIEA6,
  edu_adult = PIEA19A,
  edu_years  = as.numeric(PIEA17), #years
  edu_child = NA,
  ethnicity = NA,
  
  #diabetes
  self_db      = MHEA16, #diabetes ever
  age_told_db  = as.numeric(MHEA16A),
  drug_insu_db = MHEA16C,
  drug_pill_db = MUEA33C, #but only last 4 weeks
  family_hx_db = NA,
  
  #labs
  fasting_minutes = NA,
  fasting_hours   = NA,
  fasting_8h      = NA,
  fasting_12h     = NA,
  fglu         = as.numeric(LABA70), units_fglu  = 'mg/dL',
  hba1c        = as.numeric(LABA72), units_hba1c = 'NA',
  pogtt          = NA, units_pogtt   = 'NA',
  insulin      = NA, units_insulin = 'NA',
  
  creatinine_urine = as.numeric(LABA76), creatinine_urine_units = 'mg/dL',
  
  total_cholesterol        = as.numeric(LABA66), units_cholesterol = NA,
  ldl                      = as.numeric(LABA69), units_ldl = 'mg/dL',

  #tb
  tb_history = RSEA50,
  age_told_tb  = NA,
  tb_treatment = RSEA51,
  tb_skin_test = RSEA52, #self-reported
  tb_skin_test_result = RSEA53, #self-reported
  tb_medication_use = RSEA54,
  
  # Measurements
  weight                   = as.numeric(ANTA4), units_weight = 'kg',
  height                   = as.numeric(HEIGHT), units_height = 'cm',
  bmi                      = as.numeric(BMI), units_bmi = 'KG/M**2',
  waist                    = as.numeric(ANTA10A), units_waist = 'cm',            # just 1 measure
  hip                      = as.numeric(ANTA10B), units_waist = 'cm',                                
  # These will be converted into blood_pressure_sys and blood_pressure_diast later
  blood_pressure_sys2       = as.numeric(SBPA11), units_sbp = 'mmHg',
  blood_pressure_sys3       = as.numeric(SBPA14), units_sbp = 'mmHg',
  blood_pressure_diast2     = as.numeric(SBPA12),
  blood_pressure_diast3     = as.numeric(SBPA15)
)

detach(data_sol_v1)

```

# Re-coding V1 and V2 datasets
```{r sol recode, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
recode_sol <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(

      # sex
      sex = case_when(
        sex == 1 ~ 1,  # men
        sex == 2 ~ 2,  # women
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),

      # yes/no variables
      across(
        c(self_db, drug_insu_db, drug_pill_db,
          tb_history, tb_treatment, tb_skin_test),
        ~ case_when(
          . == 1 ~ 1,
          . == 0 ~ 0,
          . %in% c(2, 9) ~ 9,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
      ),

      # TB skin test result
      tb_skin_test_result = case_when(
        tb_skin_test_result == 2 ~ 0,                 # negative
        tb_skin_test_result == 1 ~ 1,                 # positive
        tb_skin_test_result %in% c("Q", 9) ~ 9,       # DK
        tb_skin_test_result == "S" ~ NA_real_,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),

      # TB medication use after positive test
      tb_medication_use = case_when(
        tb_medication_use == 0 ~ 0,
        tb_medication_use == 1 ~ 1,
        tb_medication_use == 9 ~ 9,
        tb_medication_use == "S" ~ NA_real_,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),

      # race (among hispanics)
      race = case_when(
        race %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) ~ 2,  # hispanic
        race %in% c("Q", 9) ~ 9,            # DK
        TRUE ~ NA_real_                     # missing
      ),
      
      # ethnicity (all Hispanics)
      ethnicity = case_when(
        TRUE ~ 2                 # Hispanics
      ),

      # education
      edu_adult = case_when(
        edu_adult %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1,    # < HS
        edu_adult == 3 ~ 2,            # HS
        edu_adult %in% c(4, 5) ~ 3,    # some college+
        edu_adult %in% c(6, "Q") ~ 9,  # refused / DK
        edu_adult == "S" ~ 9,
        TRUE ~ 9
      )
      )
  }

# Recode datasets (SOL V1, V2)
df_sol_v1 <- recode_sol(df_sol_v1)
df_sol_v2 <- recode_sol(df_sol_v2)


```

# Diabetes definitions

```{r data transf, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Diabetes: Self reported / labs (fasting glucose, HbA1c, oral glucose tolerance test)
create_self_lab_dm <- function(dm) {
  dm %>%
    mutate(
      self_lab_dm = case_when(
        self_db == 1 | fglu >= 126 | hba1c >= 6.5 | pogtt >= 200 ~ 1,
        !is.na(self_db) | !is.na(fglu) | !is.na(hba1c) | !is.na(pogtt) ~ 0,
        is.na(self_db) & is.na(fglu) & is.na(hba1c) & is.na(pogtt) ~ NA_real_
      )
    )
}

df_sol_v1 <- create_self_lab_dm(df_sol_v1)
df_sol_v2 <- create_self_lab_dm(df_sol_v2)

```

# Generating same SBP and DBP as other datasets
```{r blood pressure, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}

# Average of blood pressure measurement (systolic and diastolic #2 + #3 / 2)
process_bp <- function(df) {
  df$blood_pressure_sys   <- (df$blood_pressure_sys2 + df$blood_pressure_sys3) / 2
  df$blood_pressure_diast <- (df$blood_pressure_diast2 + df$blood_pressure_diast3) / 2
  
  df <- subset(df, select = -c(blood_pressure_sys2,
                               blood_pressure_sys3,
                               blood_pressure_diast2,
                               blood_pressure_diast3))
  return(df)
}

df_sol_v1 <- process_bp(df_sol_v1)
df_sol_v2 <- process_bp(df_sol_v2)

# Summary of numeric variables - 1999

summary(df_sol_v1$blood_pressure_diast)

    blood_pressure_sys = ifelse(
      blood_pressure_sys >= 70 & blood_pressure_sys <= 270,

    ),

      blood_pressure_diast >= 30 & blood_pressure_diast <= 150,

    )
```

# Labeling both datasets

```{r labeling, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
label_sol <- function(label) {
  label %>%
    mutate(
      # Sex
      sex = factor(sex,
                   levels = c(1, 2),
                   labels = c("Men", "Women")),

      # TB variables
      tb_history = factor(tb_history,
                          levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                          labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      tb_treatment = factor(tb_treatment,
                            levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                            labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      tb_skin_test = factor(tb_skin_test,
                            levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                            labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      tb_skin_test_result = factor(tb_skin_test_result,
                                   levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                                   labels = c("Positive", "Negative", "Refused/DK")),
      tb_medication_use = factor(tb_medication_use,
                                 levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                                 labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),

      # Diabetes self-report + labs
      self_db = factor(self_db,
                       levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                       labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      drug_insu_db = factor(drug_insu_db,
                            levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                            labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      drug_pill_db = factor(drug_pill_db,
                            levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                            labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      self_lab_dm = factor(self_lab_dm,
                           levels = c(1, 0),
                           labels = c("Diabetes", "No Diabetes")),

      # Family history
      family_hx_db = factor(family_hx_db,
                            levels = c(1, 0),
                            labels = c("Yes", "No")),

      # Race/Ethnicity
      race = factor(race,
                    levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 9),
                    labels = c("Non-Hispanic Black", 
                               "Non-Hispanic White", 
                               "Mexican/Other Hispanic", 
                               "Other/Multiracial", 
                               "Missing")),
      ethnicity = factor(ethnicity,
                         levels = c(1, 2, 9),
                         labels = c("Non-Hispanic", "Hispanic", "Missing")),

      # Education
      edu_adult = factor(edu_adult,
                         levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 9),
                         labels = c("< High School", 
                                    "High School Grad", 
                                    "Some College/AA", 
                                    "College+", 
                                    "Refused/DK"))
    )
}

df_sol_v1 <- label_sol(df_sol_v1)
df_sol_v2 <- label_sol(df_sol_v2)


```

```{r dm_tb, , echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
    mutate(

                   levels = c(0, 1),
                   labels = c("No", "Yes"))
```

```{r, CARDIA TABLE (Y10), message=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
# Select the variables you want to include
vars_to_summarize <- c(
  "age", "sex", "race", "edu_adult", "self_db", "age_told_db", "drug_insu_db", "drug_pill_db",
  "self_lab_dm", "family_hx_db",
  "tb_history", "age_told_tb", "tb_treatment", "fasting_minutes", "fglu", "hba1c", "total_cholesterol", "ldl", "weight", "height", "bmi",  "waist", "hip", "blood_pressure_sys", "blood_pressure_diast", "tb_dm")

# Create table1
SOL_V1_table <- df_sol_v1 %>%
  select(all_of(vars_to_summarize), tb_dm) %>%  # include the grouping variable
  tbl_summary(
    by = tb_dm,  # group by TB+DM
    type = list(
      age ~ "continuous",
      age_told_db ~ "continuous",
      age_told_tb ~ "continuous",
      fglu ~ "continuous",
      hba1c ~ "continuous",
      fasting_minutes ~ "continuous",
      total_cholesterol ~ "continuous",
      ldl ~ "continuous",
      weight ~ "continuous",
      height ~ "continuous",
      bmi ~ "continuous",
      waist ~ "continuous",
      hip ~ "continuous",
      blood_pressure_sys ~ "continuous",
      blood_pressure_diast ~ "continuous"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} / {N} ({p}%)"
    ),
    label = var_label(df_sol_v1),
    missing = "no"
  ) 

SOL_V1_table <- SOL_V1_table %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variables**") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(c(stat_1, stat_2) ~ "**Summary Statistics (SOL V1)**")

SOL_V1_table

```
